zugriff._hinweis: Texts of the game-access adapters (pesm/adapters/pes): messages and reasons passed to the interface. Placeholders %1, %2 …
zugriff.weg_a.nicht_geladen: %1 is loaded in the game, %2 is released
zugriff.weg_a.kein_testplatz: %1 is not registered as a test slot
zugriff.weg_a.nicht_unterscheidbar: the state of %1 equals that of %2; the module could not tell them apart
zugriff.weg_a.keine_routinen: routinen.json is missing (description of the routines)
zugriff.weg_a.sicherung_fehlgeschlagen: Backup of the test slot not created; nothing stored
zugriff.weg_a.zu_spaet: The order has already been executed or ended
zugriff.weg_a.eingereiht_braucht_scharf: The order is already queued in the game; Route A must be on and live to cancel it
zugriff.weg_a.budget_nicht_verglichen: Budget in memory not yet compared with the file (budget_vergleichen)
zugriff.weg_a.budget_krumm: Budget values invalid (whole euros, divisible by 100)
zugriff.weg_a.name_ungueltig: Name invalid (1 to 14 bytes UTF-8, no control characters)
zugriff.weg_a.vs_art_unbekannt: Kind %1 unknown (commands of the change list: pesm.adapters.pes.weg_a_befehle)
zugriff.weg_a.rueckholdatum_fehlt: Return date of the loan is missing
zugriff.weg_a.abloese_ohne_vergleich: Transfer fee only after a successful budget comparison (budget_vergleichen)
zugriff.weg_a.lesend_einschalten: Read command: switching Route A on is not allowed here
zugriff.weg_a.lesend_auftrag: Read command: no order may be stored
zugriff.felder.nur_byte: Entry %1: %2 is not displayed from the record in the game (byte only); not writable
zugriff.felder.ungeprueft: Entry %1: %2: display in the game not yet confirmed (felder_anzeige.toml); test mode only
zugriff.felder.teamrolle: Entry %1: team role %2 does not occur in the game
zugriff.felder.zehn: Player %1: %2 special abilities, at most %3 (the game takes no more); nothing written
zugriff.verbindung.kein_herzschlag: The game has not reported in
zugriff.verbindung.laedt: The game is loading, saving or resting in the background (no word for %1 s, but it is running)
zugriff.verbindung.modul_fehlt: The game is running, but the add-on has been silent for %1 s
zugriff.verbindung.kein_briefkasten: The courier has no tray in the game yet
zugriff.befehle.kein_weg_art: there is no way for this kind (loan, transfer list, …)
zugriff.befehle.trainer: Coach change at %1: %2 (takes effect after saving and advancing)
zugriff.weg_a.trainer_baustein_alt: The installed game link (older than 0.3.38) cannot carry out coach changes
zugriff.befehle.doppelt: equals the fee of a transfer that books the budget itself (otherwise booked twice)
zugriff.befehle.ziel_unbestimmt: player or target club cannot be determined
zugriff.befehle.wechsel: Transfer of player %1 to club %2, fee €%3 (%4); takes effect at the next day rollover
zugriff.befehle.doppelt_nicht: The fee is booked by the transfer; the budget entry is not executed in addition
zugriff.sd.nicht_bestaetigt: not confirmed by the user; nothing written
zugriff.sd.platz_unbekannt: Save slot %1 is not offered in data set %2
zugriff.sd.spiel_laeuft: The game is running; the change is only handed over while the game is closed.
zugriff.sd.datei_eben: the save file was only just changed; try again in ten seconds
zugriff.sd.sicherung_kein_spielstand: backup %1 is not a save game (%2); nothing written
zugriff.sd.kein_herzschlag: The game is not listening right now: it is not running or the add-on is silent.
zugriff.sd.ohne_sitzung: The add-on in the game is an older version and does not know this session.
zugriff.sd.speicherzugriff_aus: memory access of the module is off
zugriff.sd.karriere_laden: Career not loaded: load the Master League and stay in the menu
zugriff.sd.welt_schon: a world run already ran in this load of the career: reload the career
zugriff.sd.welt_beginnt: the module starts in a few seconds: stay in the Master League menu, do not start a match, do not advance a day
zugriff.sd.briefkasten_fehlt: The courier has no tray in the game yet: set up the connection under "Connect game".
zugriff.sd.protokoll_nicht: The ledger of changes was not kept (%1).
zugriff.sd.feld_nicht_freigegeben: (this field is not released for the write service)
zugriff.sd.feld_nicht_in_liste: Field %1 is not in the release list; only the 25 abilities and confirmed fields are writable%2
zugriff.sd.kennung_ungueltig: reserved ID invalid (1–64 characters: letters, digits, “-”, “_”)
zugriff.sd.db_zustand: The career archive %1: %2 (please read the save again)
zugriff.sd.kein_spieler: no player at record index %1 in the data set
zugriff.sd.werte_fehlen: values of the player are missing in the data set: %1 (re-read)
zugriff.sd.kennung_anderer: ID %1 is reserved for another player or another field
zugriff.sd.nichts_abzuschliessen: nothing to complete yet (%1 orders are waiting or being checked)
zugriff.sd.nicht_ausgefuehrt: Order %1 has not been executed (%2); nothing to roll back
zugriff.sd.nicht_im_journal: Order %1 is not in the journal
zugriff.sd.ruecknahme_ruecknahme: a rollback cannot be rolled back
zugriff.sd.ruecknahme_schon: a rollback has already been issued for order %1
zugriff.sd.spaeter_zuerst: later order %1 on the same field must be rolled back first
zugriff.sd.welt_endet: ; the running run ends by itself
zugriff.au.nicht_in_liste: %1 is not in the release list
zugriff.au.kein_vorher: no previous value for %1 in the data set
zugriff.au.keine_sitzung: The game reported no session (is the add-on active?)
zugriff.au.ruecknahme_sitzung: Rollback only in the session of the order (the game has been restarted since)
zugriff.au.noch_offen: Order %1 is still open (complete it first)
zugriff.au.in_schlange: Order %1 is already in the queue
zugriff.zg.aenderte: file changed while copying; read again later
zugriff.zg.leer: file is empty (being written right now)
zugriff.zg.keine_ruhe: file does not settle (game still saving?); read again later
zugriff.zg.keine_edit: Names not available: no edit file
zugriff.zg.kopieren: Copying the save into a working folder
zugriff.el.abgebrochen: Reading was cancelled; the archive was not changed
zugriff.el.bestand_fremd: The values from the previous archive belong to another save or club: not carried over
zugriff.el.ids_abweichend: %1 record indexes carry another player ID in the save than in the previous data: nothing carried over there
zugriff.el.bestand_uebernommen: Values carried over from the previous archive: %1 players (as of %2); anything newer in the save comes from the save
zugriff.el.welt_lagen: The world file needs the layouts of the version file
zugriff.el.welt_aelter: World file (%1) is older than the save (%2): only values the save does not have
zugriff.el.schnappschuss_aelter: Snapshot (%1) is older than the save (%2): only values the save does not have
zugriff.el.db_fremd: The archive belongs to another save or club
zugriff.el.spielstand_aelter: Save (%1) is older than the one already read (%2)
zugriff.el.neue_saetze: %1 new player records: profile and short name only come with a world file
zugriff.bk.profil_fehlt: Profile %1 is missing in the prefix
zugriff.bk.users_fehlt: drive_c/users is missing in the prefix
zugriff.bk.profil_mehrdeutig: Profile in the prefix is ambiguous (%1 directories)
zugriff.bk.nur_eingang: only messages from eingang/ are acknowledged
zugriff.el.welt_anderer_verein: World file of another club (%1) not used
zugriff.el.ids_speicher: %1 record indexes carry another player ID in memory than in the save
zugriff.el.schnappschuss_anderer_verein: Snapshot of another club (%1) not used
zugriff.verbindung.yama: (Yama ptrace_scope=%1: parent process/permissions only; setcap cap_sys_ptrace or ptrace_scope 0)
zugriff.weg_a.kein_datum: The budget could not be read live from the game (game not running, career not loaded, or module older than 0.3.15)
zugriff.befehle.budget_abweichend: Budget in the game differs from the file
zugriff.el.quelle_edit: Edit file: %1 names, %2 of %3 squad players among them
zugriff.el.quelle_schnappschuss_fehlt: no squad snapshot from the game (game not started or career not loaded)
zugriff.el.quelle_schnappschuss_leer: squad snapshot without players (the module does not know this career's squad: kader.json is missing or belongs to another club)
zugriff.el.quelle_schnappschuss_verein: squad snapshot belongs to club %1, the save to club %2
zugriff.el.quelle_welt_fehlt: no world file (world run off or not yet done)
zugriff.el.quelle_welt_verein: world file belongs to club %1, the save to club %2
zugriff.el.namen_fehlen: Player names could not be read: %1
zugriff.el.namen_teilweise: Names are missing for %1 of %2 squad players: %3
zugriff.el.nachlauf_namen: Follow-up run: %1 of %2 squad players without a name
zugriff.db.journal_zurueckgesetzt: The last operation was interrupted and rolled back
zugriff.weg_a.taktik_wechsel_offen: A transfer is queued: do not mix tactics writing and transfer execution in the same match day
zugriff.weg_a.wechsel_nach_taktik: Tactics were written today: the transfer execution rebuilds the line-up, so not on the same match day
zugriff.weg_a.spiel_laeuft_nicht: The game is not listening (no fresh sign of life from the game): nothing queued. Start the game, load the career and try again.
zugriff.befehle.budget_diff: %1: %2 in the game, %3 in the saved game – %4 in the game (%5).
zugriff.befehle.datum_diff: Game date %1 in the game, %2 in the saved game.
zugriff.befehle.budget_warten: The transfer stays pending. Save in the game: PESM then reads the save itself and triggers the transfer.
zugriff.weg_a.budget_speicher_neuer: The game memory is newer: the transfer budget in the game is %1 €, the file has %2 €. Save in the game, then repeat the comparison.
zugriff.weg_a.budget_datei_neuer: The file is newer: game date in memory %1, in the file %2. Reload the career in the game (main menu, load), then repeat the comparison.
zugriff.weg_a.karriere_nicht_geladen: The game is running but no career is loaded: nothing queued.
zugriff.weg_a.stand_nicht_frisch: The game state (budget, date, club) could not be read fresh: the game must be running, the career loaded and the module answering. Nothing was queued.
zugriff.weg_a.stand_uneinheitlich: The game state is inconsistent (sign of life: date %1, club %2; read fresh: date %3, club %4). Nothing was queued; try again in a moment.
